# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]
* [Our sustainability policies][8

Employment Opportunities
Working at Azelis

We embrace change as an invaluable opportunity to grow, learn and become even better at what we do.
As do our people. Azelis currently employs more than 4,100 talented individuals in 64 countries. And
counting.

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

### Work with us

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

[Discover our career opportunities][94]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains. 

[Learn more][95]
We provide high quality raw materials, sourced from leading global manufacturers. Our technical team
can provide you with sampling, formulation and expertise.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to

## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

[View Investor Relations][118]

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

**About Us**
Buske Logistics is a privately owned and operated third-party logistics (3PL) warehousing business
founded in 1923. Since 2009, the company has undergone a significant transformation, with Fortune
1,000 standards being implemented under the ownership of S.C. Johnson & Son, Inc. from 2009 to 2015.

New and enhanced systems, processes, and people development have been priorities under the current
management team, which acquired the company in 2015. Most recently, we have accelerated our capital
investments through a partnership with Fourshore Partners in March of 2022.

We are a global company providing a wide array of best-in-class logistics services to Fortune 500
clients in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Since our inception, we have been committed to offering our
partners the kind of personal attention that results in quick answers, superior value, cutting-edge
technology, and the most reliable performance in our industry.

## **42 Locations**

[Image of Buske's 30 locations across the U.S. and Canada]

## **Our History**

Our 100+ year history in the warehousing and logistics industry, combined with our ever-evolving
innovation and technological capabilities, keeps us firmly planted as a preeminent 3PL organization.

Since day one, we’ve fulfilled the most demanding needs of Fortune 1,000 companies across various
industries, from food and beverage to automotive manufacturing.

management team, which acquired the company in 2015. Most recently, we have accelerated our capital
investments through a partnership with Fourshore Partners in March of 2022.

We are a global company providing a wide array of best-in-class logistics services to Fortune 500
clients in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Since our inception, we have been committed to offering our
partners the kind of personal attention that results in quick answers, superior value, cutting-edge

industries, from food and beverage to automotive manufacturing.

# Cailà&Parés Empresa Oleoquímica

## Fabricación y Distribución de Productos Oleoquímicos

Cailà y Parés S.A. es una empresa oleoquímica con casi 100 años de historia realizando la
**fabricación ** y **distribución de ácidos y aceites grasos** a diferentes zonas del mundo. Puede
conocer más detalles sobre nuestra planta oleoquímica haciendo clic sobre los enlaces inferiores
para comenzar a navegar y conocer más sobre Cailà y Parés, como nuestros productos oleoquímicos, el
cumplimiento de la política medioambiental o conocer alguno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

### Fabricación de Ácidos Grasos fuera del ámbito de aplicación del EUDR (Non-EUDR)

Nuestros ácidos grasos Non-EUDR se fabrican en España utilizando materias primas de origen vegetal
fuera del alcance de la normativa EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). Apostamos por un
abastecimiento responsable y sostenible, priorizando cadenas de suministro trazables y rutas
logísticas cortas dentro de Europa. Gracias al origen de nuestras materias primas y a la proximidad
de la cadena de suministro, contribuimos a reducir la huella de carbono asociada al producto y al
transporte.

### Venta de Ácidos Grasos y Especialidades Químicas para la Industria

Descubre nuestra empresa líder en la fabricación y distribución de productos oleoquímicos de alta
calidad. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles para diversas
aplicaciones industriales. Nuestros [**productos oleoquímicos**][31], derivados de fuentes
naturales, **cumplen con los estándares más exigentes, garantizando eficacia, confiabilidad y
respeto por el medio ambiente.** Colaboramos estrechamente con nuestros clientes para satisfacer sus
necesidades específicas y proporcionar soluciones a medida. Explora nuestra gama de productos y
descubre cómo podemos impulsar el éxito de tu negocio con nuestros productos oleoquímicos de
vanguardia.

# Cailà&Parés Empresa Oleoquímica

## Fabricación y Distribución de Productos Oleoquímicos

Cailà y Parés S.A. es una empresa oleoquímica con casi 100 años de historia realizando la
**fabricación ** y **distribución de ácidos y aceites grasos** a diferentes zonas del mundo. Puede
conocer más detalles sobre nuestra planta oleoquímica haciendo clic sobre los enlaces inferiores
para comenzar a navegar y conocer más sobre Cailà y Parés, como nuestros productos oleoquímicos, el
cumplimiento de la política medioambiental o conocer alguno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

### Fabricación de Ácidos Grasos fuera del ámbito de aplicación del EUDR (Non-EUDR)

Nuestros ácidos grasos Non-EUDR se fabrican en España utilizando materias primas de origen vegetal
fuera del alcance de la normativa EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). Apostamos por un
abastecimiento responsable y sostenible, priorizando cadenas de suministro trazables y rutas
logísticas cortas dentro de Europa. Gracias al origen de nuestras materias primas y a la proximidad
de la cadena de suministro, contribuimos a reducir la huella de carbono asociada al producto y al
transporte.

### Venta de Ácidos Grasos y Especialidades Químicas para la Industria

Descubre nuestra empresa líder en la fabricación y distribución de productos oleoquímicos de alta
calidad. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles para diversas
aplicaciones industriales. Nuestros [**productos oleoquímicos**][31], derivados de fuentes
naturales, **cumplen con los estándares más exigentes, garantizando eficacia, confiabilidad y
respeto por el medio ambiente.** Colaboramos estrechamente con nuestros clientes para satisfacer sus
necesidades específicas y proporcionar soluciones a medida. Explora nuestra gama de productos y
descubre cómo podemos impulsar el éxito de tu negocio con nuestros productos oleoquímicos de
vanguardia.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

to providing quality in the worldwide marketplace.

We founded our trading company to serve a variety of fatty acids, soap noodles, and glycerin after
MSD Global saw the potential presented by the plentiful supply of palm oil and palm kernel oil in
Malaysia and Indonesia, as well as the preference for vegetable-based oleochemicals in numerous
industries.

Glycerine, soap noodles, and fatty acids derived from palm oil are now commonly available in
international markets. We are now able to supply the United States, Europe, Africa, the Middle East,
and other nations with high-quality Soap Noodles, Palm Oil, Amides And Betaine, Vegetable Fats,
Refined Glycerin and more.

We have partnerships with important sourcing and supply markets in Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand
that create a variety of premium sustainable oleochemicals made from feedstock derived from
vegetables. Our product line includes fatty alcohols, fatty esters, basic fatty acids, and
glycerine. Numerous end-use applications make use of our products.

Green chemicals, sustainable development, and environmental friendliness are the new priorities of
modern society.

MSD Global has had notable expansion. This was made possible by competent management at every level
of our organization, dependable relationships with our manufacturers, andabove allour ability to
handle large volumes of business and provide our clients with high-quality materials. We are
concentrating on new downstream business, supported by a strong confidence in innovation and
thorough market research.

**Vision and Mission**

* To be a leader in providing quality oleochemicals and associated products by meeting customer
  needs through continuous improvement and sustained long-term growth in volume and profitability.
* Our business activities are oleochemicals, speciality fats and edible oil. Our portfolio of
  customers includes personal care, soap & detergent, cosmetics & toiletries, pharmaceuticals, food
  additives, rubber & latex, paints, inks & coatings, candle & waxes, Grease & lubricants, resins,
  animal feed products
* Through our large-volume business integration and logistical advantages of its business model, MSD
  global operates on very sharp margins as well as provides competitive pricing for the benefit of
  its final customers.

**Core Values**

* **Customer Centric- **To be a leading trading company in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To keep abreast of technological developments in the fats & oils production and
  related fields
* **Credibility & Integrity- **We maintain honesty, trustworthiness, and high ethical standards. We
  will continue serving our customers better by setting high standards for our products and people.
  We believe a mutually beneficial relationship serves the cause of long term partnership with our
  customers and manufacturers.
* **Leader-** To be one of the leading trading companies in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To be in tune with technological advancements in the fats & oils production and
  related fields.
* **Focused- **We are Focused and committed to building Real and long lasting Partnerships with all
  our manufacturers and customers, this is critical in achieving sustainability and prolonged
  success.
* **Innovation- **We cherish innovative efforts, ideas, and methods to continue to improve our
  business process. Fresh creative ideas that result in an extended range of products and solutions
  with added value serve as one stop solutions and provide a strong competitive edge for the success
  of our customer and clients.
* **Team Work- **We work as a team to achieve our corporate goal.

**Our Pillars Of Our Success

Reliable Services**

Reliable supply of high-quality goods. Effective worldwide distribution and network supply made
possible by an internal operations and logistics team, as well as extensive customer and product
support. Our logistics and distribution network is extensive. Logistics: We have a dedicated
logistics and operations team that can manage the transportation of huge quantities of containers as
part of our distribution capabilities. Additionally, we have partnerships with the biggest and most
reputable international logistics firms, which enable us to transport materials around the world
with ease.

**Manufacturers**

We aim for greatness. At the core of our business are highly automated, ISO and GMP certified
factories with state-of-the-art facilities that have been thoughtfully designed and built with
functionality in mind. To guarantee quality and worldwide supply continuity, we meticulously oversee
every step of the production, packaging, and logistics planning processes. Modern development labs
run by our manufacturers offer services for testing, product development, and custom formulations.
Our producers are prepared to create innovative goods or enhance the qualities of their current
models. At the heart of all we do is innovation.

**Market Research & Analysis**

We have a unique real-time insight of industry trends because to our extensive client base and
market research department. Understanding the markets they serve and the clients they represent is
the first step in developing a successful marketing plan. With a worldwide viewpoint, MSD worldwide
monitors daily palm oil prices and market trends. To create a comprehensive picture of competition
pricing and product offering, we support our observations with the viewpoints of industry experts.

**Product Positioning**

We are aware of product life cycles and how they relate to consumer needs. We may customize product
qualities based on customer preferences by using a wide variety of oleochemicals.

**Analytical Labs**

MSD worldwide manufacturers follow GMP/FDA guidelines while maintaining testing procedures and
documentation. Moisture, free fatty acid/free alkaline, salt, and active ingredient testing are all
ongoing oleochemical assays.

Testing methods:

* Liquid Chromatographs
* Uv Visible Spectrometer
* Karl Fisher Auto Titrators

**Quality**

Our company always places a high premium on quality assurance, and we take great satisfaction in our
relationships with top manufacturers who adhere to strict QC guidelines. Every production facility
has the most recent standard operating procedure in place and is routinely audited. MSD Global
offers a distinct perspective on specialty fats and oleochemicals. We attain unheard-of control over
our manufacturing by integrating our manufacturer's expertise with the newest systems and
cutting-edge technologies. Our manufacturer's quality advantage is a result of comprehensive testing
of incoming feedstock, computerized process modeling, state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment, and
diligent employees. Our top-tier quality processes are acknowledged by our esteemed clients
worldwide.

### Instant Access to Warehousing & Distribution Nationwide

OLIMP Warehousing connects businesses to flexible, on-demand warehousing and logistics solutions
across the U.S. and Canada. With access to 5,000+ warehouse locations, we help you secure space
exactly when and where you need it-no long-term contracts, just fast, efficient support.

Our platform simplifies the search and booking process with instant quotes, vetted providers, and
dedicated customer service. Whether you need overflow storage, fulfillment support, or a long-term
warehousing partner, OLIMP delivers scalable solutions to keep your supply chain moving.
[Book Local Warehouse Space][67]
[Discover the ideal warehousing and fulfillment partner for your business, providing tailored

### Flexible Warehousing & Fulfillment Solutions

We deliver tailored warehousing solutions for businesses of all sizes, from [on-demand short-term
storage][68] for freight brokers and distributors to large-scale [warehouse space for retailers][69]
and manufacturers. Our services adapt to your industry’s needs: we can accommodate special
requirements like [temperature-controlled storage][70] for perishable goods or handling of oversized
equipment. In addition, we offer on-demand fulfillment support for e-commerce operations, enabling
you to manage order distribution efficiently without investing in your own warehouse infrastructure.
By partnering with OLIMP, you gain a reliable warehousing and fulfillment ally that gives you
flexibility and control over your logistics as your business grows.
[Browse Fulfillment Services][71]
[Forklift moving goods inside a large warehouse specializing in storage and warehousing services.]

### Speed Up Deliveries with Cross-Docking Services

Cross-docking through OLIMP’s network keeps your freight moving fast by transferring shipments
directly from incoming trucks to outgoing trucks with little to no storage time in between. This
practice minimizes handling and storage costs while accelerating delivery times. Our on-demand
platform gives you instant access to cross-dock facilities nationwide whenever and wherever you need
them, helping you avoid delays and keep your supply chain lean. By combining cross-docking with our
coordinated [delivery services ][72] we ensure your goods reach their next destination quickly and
efficiently.
[Book Cross Docking Service][73]
[Truck unloading goods at a warehouse for fast cross docking and delivery.]

### Smart and Affordable Shipping with Consolidated Freight

OLIMP’s consolidated freight service helps you ship more efficiently by combining smaller loads
headed in the same direction into a single shipment. Rather than paying for half-empty trucks or
containers, you only pay for the space you actually use, an approach that can significantly lower
your transport costs (up to 25% savings in some cases).

Consolidation is ideal for LTL (less-than-truckload) or LCL (less-than-container-load) freight that
doesn’t fill an entire trailer on its own. Our team handles all the planning and coordination,
grouping compatible shipments and scheduling them for departure. You get a reliable delivery with
full transparency along the way, and no wasted space or budget.
[View Freight Consolidation Services][74]
[Forklift moving pallets in a warehouse as part of a consolidated freight shipment for efficient
transport.]

### Fast Freight Rework & Pallet Restacking

If a shipment is delayed due to shifted pallets, damaged goods, or a load rejection at a receiver,
OLIMP can get it back on track quickly. We provide prompt, reliable freight rework and pallet
restacking services through our warehouses across North America, handling everything from minor
pallet damage to completely shifted loads. Our experienced teams will unload, inspect, and re-stack
or repackage your freight as needed to meet all delivery and compliance standards. With OLIMP
handling your rework needs, you can minimize downtime and avoid costly penalties, ensuring your
corrected shipment is ready for re-delivery.
[Request a Rework Quote][75]
[Warehouse workers restacking and reworking freight on pallets to prepare for re-delivery after load
rejection.]

### Seamless Port-to-Warehouse Transloading & Drayage Solutions

Our transloading and drayage services bridge the gap between ports and warehouses, making
international and intermodal shipping smoother. OLIMP arranges the swift transfer of your cargo from
ocean containers to trucks or rail at the port, helping you avoid congestion and hefty demurrage or
detention fees. With operations available 24/7 and specialized equipment to handle sensitive or
heavy freight, we ensure your goods are safely moved from the port to a warehouse without delay. You
can trust our certified drayage partners for reliable first- and last-mile transportation of your
containers – keeping your imports and exports on schedule from ship to shore.
[See Transloading Services][76]
[OLIMP's efficient port transloading and container drayage services that reduce freight delays and

If you operate a retail, general, bonded, industrial or cold‑storage facility, OLIMP can help you
monetize unused space. Our platform verifies and matches your warehouse with businesses looking for
trustworthy storage solutions. Once registered, you can showcase your capabilities and start
generating new revenue without additional marketing effort.

# is your regional oleochemical supplier with a global reach

Our global network grants you access to oleochemical supplies, contract manufacturing, and
end-to-end solutions that help you improve your outcomes and reduce manufacturing costs.

CREMER has three North American facilities for oleochemical supply and manufacturing services
accessible throughout the United States and beyond. Extend your internal manufacturing capabilities
and drive growth with CREMER.
[CREMER NA has three locations in Ohio, Tennessee and Louisiana.]
[ Speak with a CREMER expert > ][37]

Our solutions provide the highest quality oleochemical supplies, toll manufacturing or end-to-end
services for global markets across these services and more. Let us know how we can help you.

# MANUFACTURING SOLUTIONS

We hold our manufacturing, logistics, and lab services to the highest standards to stay compliant

[ Contract Manufacturing ][46] [ Pastillation & Flaking ][47] [ Drumming & Toting ][48] [ Blending &

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.
[ CONTACT US > ][58]

# CREMER North America

# is your regional oleochemical supplier with a global reach

Our global network grants you access to oleochemical supplies, contract manufacturing, and
end-to-end solutions that help you improve your outcomes and reduce manufacturing costs.

CREMER has three North American facilities for oleochemical supply and manufacturing services
accessible throughout the United States and beyond. Extend your internal manufacturing capabilities
and drive growth with CREMER.
[CREMER NA has three locations in Ohio, Tennessee and Louisiana.]
[ Speak with a CREMER expert > ][37]

# INDUSTRIES WE SERVE

Our solutions provide the highest quality oleochemical supplies, toll manufacturing or end-to-end
services for global markets across these services and more. Let us know how we can help you.
Pet Care, Food & Treats
Personal Care & Cosmetics
Household & Industrial Cleaning
Adhesives. Sealings & Coatings
Lubricants & Greases
Food & Beverage
Pharmaceuticals
Agriculture
Rubber & Plastic Additives
Oil & Gas
[ CONTACT US > ][38]

# OLEOCHEMICALS WE SUPPLY

We provide kosher, non-kosher, and food-safe oleochemicals in volumes ranging from drum to tote to
tanker.
[ Oleochemicals ][39] [ Fatty Acids ][40] [ Fatty Alcohols ][41] [ Glycerin & Propylene Glycol ][42]
[ Methyl Esters ][43] [ Soap Noodles ][44]
[ CONTACT US > ][45]

# MANUFACTURING SOLUTIONS

We hold our manufacturing, logistics, and lab services to the highest standards to stay compliant
with our various certifications. We assess each manufacturing run and logistics plan to ensure
efficiency and sustainability in everything we do.
[ Contract Manufacturing ][46] [ Pastillation & Flaking ][47] [ Drumming & Toting ][48] [ Blending &
Diluting ][49] [ warehousing & Storage ][50] [ Lab Services ][51] [ Logistics ][52]
[ CONTACT US > ][53]

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.
[ CONTACT US > ][58]

онлайн-сессии и даю обратную связь.

косметологами.

###### WELCOME TO BASF AUTOMOTIVE REFINISH

# We Create Chemistry

As the world’s largest chemical company, BASF is an unmatched expert in the science of color. BASF
Automotive Refinish systems offer advanced paint technologies, set apart with products backed by
support in technical training, color information systems and business management.  BASF’s Automotive
Refinish business develops and markets the highest-quality coatings available for the collision
repair, commercial fleet and automotive specialty markets. BASF offers quality coatings and
a partner you can count on. For over 150 years, BASF Refinish has been leading the industry, and we
continue to innovate and offer our partners the best-in-class products, services and support.

At BASF, customers are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we have spent more than 150
years working side by side with you, listening to your needs and developing solutions to sustain the
future of your business. customers first

###### BASF PAINT BRANDS

### More than the best paint and the best support

As the world’s largest chemical company, BASF offers intelligent solutions based on innovative
products and tailor-made services. We create opportunities for success through trusted and reliable
partnerships. Our Automotive Refinish business makes and markets the finest coatings available for
body shops, restoration facilities, customizers and commercial transportation.

[EXPLORE BRANDS][48]

###### OEM EXPERTISE

### More than 50% of global annual car production has at least one layer of BASF paint.

From the factory assembly line to the collision repair facility, BASF coatings are used to provide
the finest, most durable finishes. That’s why BASF Refinish coatings have more OEM approvals than
any other refinish paint brand, and that’s why BASF is the best answer to getting your shop
certified for repairing OEM vehicles. BASF refinish products are approved for over 99% of cars on
the roads in North America.

Premiere automotive manufacturers Bentley and Rolls Royce want no other refinish paint used for
repairs than the world-class Glasurit brand, which holds exclusive approvals.

[OEM SERVICES][49]

## About Us

[Surfactant]

As a global Contract Research Organization (CRO), headquartered in New York, USA, Alfa Chemistry has
served the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries for years. Today, Alfa Chemistry is
specialized in organic chemistry, material chemistry, and medicinal chemistry.

[More info > ][61]
* [High Quality]
* High Quality
  
  After years of experience accumulation and technical innovation, we provide high quality
  surfactants to various organizations around the world.
* [Excellent customer service]
* Excellent Customer Service
  
  An excellent sales team & Professional technical staff.
* [Rich Experience]
* Rich Experience
  
  We have dealt with lots of products and our customers are around the world.

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

  Alfa Chemistry provides you with high quality surfactants and offers full support to meet your

## About Us

[Surfactant]

As a global Contract Research Organization (CRO), headquartered in New York, USA, Alfa Chemistry has
served the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries for years. Today, Alfa Chemistry is
specialized in organic chemistry, material chemistry, and medicinal chemistry.

[More info > ][61]
* [High Quality]
* High Quality
  
  After years of experience accumulation and technical innovation, we provide high quality
  surfactants to various organizations around the world.
* [Excellent customer service]
* Excellent Customer Service
  
  An excellent sales team & Professional technical staff.
* [Rich Experience]
* Rich Experience
  
  We have dealt with lots of products and our customers are around the world.

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

Keyword

# Protective.
# Emotive.
# Demand both.

From automotive and aerospace to coil and specialty, we engineer coatings and surface solutions that
protect and inspire.

[ About us ][60]
[ What we do ][61]
Image
[People on tank]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

[ Locations ][66]
Image
[Purple automotive coating]

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.
[
Image
[back 3/4 view of a white car with a sunset in the background] ][67]

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.
[Learn more][68]
[
Image
[airplane flying view from inside window of aircraft, flying above the clouds during sunset] ][69]

### Aerospace

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]
Image
[White]

## What sets us apart

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are
some of the capabilities that make us a partner unlike any other.

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image
[R-M expert] ][81]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.
[Meet our brands][82]

## Latest News

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026
[[Image of the executive committee of Surventis] ][85]
New

### [ BASF Coatings names Executive Committee to lead and drive success as a standalone company
### ][86]

MUENSTER, Germany, June 25, 2026. BASF Coatings today named the leadership team that will run the
business as an independent company from July 1, 2026, after the closing of the transaction. The new
structure brings together leaders who have built the coatings business over many years and senior
executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will
be led by incoming Chief Executive Officer Jens Luehring.
Jun 26, 2026

billion.

[ About us ][60]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

Submit

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

[ Locations ][66]
Image
[Purple automotive coating]

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.
[
Image
[back 3/4 view of a white car with a sunset in the background] ][67]

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.
[Learn more][68]
[
Image
[airplane flying view from inside window of aircraft, flying above the clouds during sunset] ][69]

### Aerospace

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]
Image
[White]

## What sets us apart

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are
some of the capabilities that make us a partner unlike any other.

[
Image
[Refinity app on tablet] ][75]

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image
[R-M expert] ][81]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.
[Meet our brands][82]
